A '''firing cell''' was a component of the [[Hoersch-Kessel ion drive]]. For optimum performance, the firing cells had to be precisely aligned with the [[Engine/Legends|engine]] [[intake]]. Regular maintenance to ensure that the firing cells stayed in alignment was advised, as improperly adjusted firing cells could lead to damaging or destruction of the drive.<ref name="SWS" />
